name: @marianmeres/sync-versions
description: Carry a pnpm workspace's root version into every member manifest, VERSION constant and the changelog — the before-commit step of a one-version release.
author: Marian Meres

scripts.ci: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run lint && pnpm test
scripts.prepublishOnly: pnpm run ci && pnpm run build
scripts.release: node src/bin.ts --preflight && pnpm run ci && npx --yes @marianmeres/release@^2.2.0 --before-commit "node src/bin.ts"
scripts.rp: pnpm run release -y --no-push && pnpm publish && git push --follow-tags
scripts.rpm: pnpm run release minor -y --no-push && pnpm publish && git push --follow-tags
